# UpdateWorld

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [World](Blitz3D-World)

</div>


```blitzbasic
UpdateWorld:Void elapsed_time:Float32=1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `elapsed_time` | In | Float32 | `1` | Animation speed of the whole world: 1 plays animations at their own speed, 2 at double speed, 0.5 at half. Defaults to 1. |

## Description

Advances the world by one step: moves animated entities on and applies the collision rules, so entities with a collision type are pushed out of the things they hit. Call it once per main loop, before [RenderWorld](RenderWorld). Without it, animations stand still and collisions never happen.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
light = CreateLight()

wall = CreateCube()
PositionEntity wall, 3, 0, 8
EntityType wall, 2
ball = CreateSphere()
PositionEntity ball, -3, 0, 8
EntityType ball, 1
EntityRadius ball, 1
Collisions 1, 2, 2, 2

While Not KeyHit(1)
	MoveEntity ball, 0.05, 0, 0
	UpdateWorld
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Wend
```
